item.title: Josh Allen’s family stood by him through rejection, injuries and NFL success
item.summary: The story of Josh Allen illustrates how unwavering support from family and relentless hard work paved his way to NFL greatness. Despite rejections and early criticism, he learned the value of consistency from his father's example. Overcoming injuries and playoff disappointments, Allen's journey reveals that the heart of success often beats stronger in the shadows, driven by family faith.
